title: Goldreich–Levin children
statement: For a natural number $n$, a coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and a set of coordinates $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, the children of $S$ at $i$ are the family consisting of $S$ and $S\cup\{i\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the first $n$ coordinates
$S$ is a set of those coordinates
